query: 供应商反腐败管理 供应商反腐败管理 衡量企业在供应链环节识别、预防及处置腐败行为的制度化水平。重点考察廉洁协议的法律约束力、针对供应商的背景尽调（Due Diligence）、定期廉洁审计及违规退出机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：合同中包含严厉的反腐败与反贿赂条款（含关联交易穿透）；建立了针对供应商实益拥有人的背景尽调机制；定期开展针对高风险采购环节的专项廉洁审计；具备明确的“黑名单”库及永久终止合作的退出机制。 • 1分（合格）：要求供应商签署标准的廉洁协议或诚信承诺书，具备基础的入驻资质审核，对违规行为有处罚说明，但缺乏深度的背景尽调、主动审计或系统化的退出流程。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商反腐政策披露，或仅有笼统的“商业道德”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：反腐败条款签署及尽调机制覆盖 >80% 的活跃供应商（或重点业务领域供应商），且定期进行反腐败宣导培训。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心/大额采购供应商执行，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商反腐败 反贿赂条款 廉洁协议 诚信承诺书 供应商尽调 实益拥有人 关联关系申报 利益冲突声明 回扣 廉洁审计 供应商黑名单 因腐败终止合作 反腐败培训 第三方风险管理 supplier anti-corruption anti-bribery clauses integrity agreement supplier due diligence beneficial ownership related-party declaration conflict of interest declaration kickback integrity audit supplier blacklist termination for corruption supplier anti-corruption training third-party risk management 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商反腐败管理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工反贿赂政策；仅有笼统商业道德；仅有供应商环境审核；仅有行为准则中一笔带过的“禁止行贿”而无尽调退出；区分：供应商反腐败管理聚焦供应链第三方腐败预防与退出；企业反贿赂管理体系更广含员工与商业伙伴；行为准则是综合文本；道德采购还可能包含冲突矿产等人权采购议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International formulated the 'Environment-Related Substance Reduction Plan Form', which imposes strict requirements on the suppliers to ban the use of heavy metals, formaldehyde, ozone hazardous substances, radioactive substances and so on. In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International clarifies the cooperation, communication, and management model with suppliers and potential suppliers at all stages through the 'Supplier Management Procedure'. Through effective management of suppliers, Ju Teng International understands suppliers' quality, price, delivery, coordination, labour, environmental protection, safety, ethics and other relevant information, and follows up and deals with supplier problems in a timely manner. For different types of suppliers, Ju Teng International has different management processes in order to manage them in a more targeted manner. For example, for the management of non-enclosure suppliers, Ju Teng International revised the relevant management requirements (on-site audit, production part approval process (PPAP) submission, quality technical agreement terms, etc.). After an abnormal problem occurs, the 8D or applicable problem solving procedures are initiated so that the abnormal problem can be solved in a timely and thorough manner.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE MANAGEMENT / Materiality identification and communication
results.text: During the Reporting Period, Ju Teng International strictly complied with the 'Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China' to protect the fair competition market and stop unfair competition practices. Meanwhile, we remain committed to managing our business practices in accordance with the 'Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) Code of Conduct', and require that the management and all employees strictly abide by it. We have established this Code as a programmatic document to achieve the Company's professional ethics, honest operation and compliance goals. Ju Teng International had not provided trainings on ethics and anti-corruption for employees during the year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. In accordance with this Code, we have formulated the internal 'Business Ethics Management Procedure' to strictly manage the business ethics of our employees. We continue to provide channels such as telephone hotlines and emails for anyone to report corruption and immorality of our employees in real names or anonymously.

results.text: Ju Teng International classifies all the suppliers into different levels (A/B/C/D) by the quality of the supplier's products and services and the degree of risk involved. Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

results.text: Following the guiding principle of 'Do It Right at First Time', taking customer satisfaction as the goal and based on the ISO 9001 international quality standard, Ju Teng International formulated two whole process operation systems such as the 'Process Inspection and Testing Procedure' and 'Unqualified Product Control Procedure', as well as operational management systems such as 'Incoming Material Control Procedure', 'Measurement and Monitoring Procedure for Finished Product Quality Inspection', and 'Corrective and Preventive Measures Control Procedure'. Strict control is carried out in the whole process of incoming materials, finished products in storage and delivery, thus forming a complete product management system.

[Section]
RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION

[Content]
Following the guiding principle of 'Do It Right at First Time', taking customer satisfaction as the goal and based on the ISO 9001 international quality standard, Ju Teng International formulated two whole process operation systems such as the 'Process Inspection and Testing Procedure' and 'Unqualified Product Control Procedure', as well as operational management systems such as 'Incoming Material Control Procedure', 'Measurement and Monitoring Procedure for Finished Product Quality Inspection', and 'Corrective and Preventive Measures Control Procedure'. Strict control is carried out in the whole process of incoming materials, finished products in storage and delivery, thus forming a complete product management system.

results.text: At the operation level of the Production Plants, in order to ensure the quality of outputs and to prevent unqualified raw materials and products from entering the next stage, 'Quality Control Personnel' (staffs of Quality Management Departments of all Production Plants) must be responsible for conducting label management on the outputs of each production stage, and inspection and testing procedures. Outputs which fail to meet the Group's quality requirements are required to be inspected and labelled. Regarding the management of unqualified products, Ju Teng International has established a whole-process inspection system to manage and inspect unqualified products from five aspects: incoming material inspection, process inspection, finished product inspection, delivery inspection and customer return. It is not allowed to release or deliver unqualified products until these products are re-inspected by the Quality Control Personnel and become qualified to ensure the quality of products leaving the factory. During the Reporting Period, no products of the Group sold or shipped were recalled for safety and health reasons.
